title: Ridgeline Installation Services Quote Validity, Minimum Job Charge and Signing Channels
content:
The installed-price quote issued at a Ridgeline Installation Services measure stays open for a set number of calendar days, may on some programs be extended once, and leads to an agreement that must meet the program's minimum job charge and be signed in one of the program's signing channels.

| Program | Quote validity (calendar days after the measure is completed) | One-time quote extension (calendar days) | Minimum installed contract price (USD) | Channels in which the agreement may be signed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Carpet Installation | 30 | 0 (no extension) | 349.00 | in the home, in the store, online |
| Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | 30 | 0 (no extension) | 399.00 | in the home, in the store, online |
| Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | 60 | 15 | 599.00 | in the home, in the store |
| Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation | 30 | 15 | 4999.00 | in the home, in the store |
| Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation | 30 | 15 | 7999.00 | in the home |
| Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | 60 | 30 | 6999.00 | in the home |

## Notes on the columns

- **Quote validity** fixes the quote expiry date: the date the measure was completed plus the program's quote validity days, in calendar days.
- **One-time quote extension** is the number of calendar days by which a quote may be extended once; a figure of 0 means the program offers no extension. The carpet and hard surface flooring programs offer none.
- **Minimum installed contract price** is the lowest contract price the program accepts.
- **Signing channels** list every channel in which the program's agreement may be signed. Online signing exists only on the carpet and hard surface flooring programs; the bath remodel and roofing and siding agreements are signed in the home only.

## Worked reading (hypothetical dates)

A Ridgeline Window and Door Installation measure completed on 3 March carries a quote expiry date 60 calendar days later, on 2 May; one extension of 15 calendar days would move that date to 17 May. A Ridgeline Carpet Installation quote has a validity of 30 days and cannot be extended at all.
